summary: Library of 1481 grainy, smooth and animated gradients plus AI backgrounds, with lifetime-access downloads.
description: A gradient asset library: noisy/grainy gradients, smooth blend gradients, abstract animated gradients and AI-generated backgrounds, organised into named collections (Ecliptic, Dither, Hero Gradients, Galactic …). Each item downloads as a 5K–8K JPG image or an MP4 animation, and a browser shader tool builds gradients in real time.
